add.name: fact_tax_point_basis
add.sql: CREATE TABLE fact_tax_point_basis(revision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES fact_revision(id),"period" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987),"business_kind" TEXT NOT NULL,"business_id" TEXT NOT NULL,"service_pattern" TEXT,"first_service_started" INTEGER CHECK("first_service_started" IN(0,1)),"first_service_period" INTEGER CHECK("first_service_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987),"first_service_date" TEXT,"first_service_source" TEXT,"written_contract_status" TEXT NOT NULL,"contract_payment_period" INTEGER CHECK("contract_payment_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987),"contract_payment_date" TEXT,"contract_source" TEXT NOT NULL,"performance_completion_period" INTEGER CHECK("performance_completion_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987),"performance_completion_date" TEXT,"performance_source" TEXT,"reviewed_through_period" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("reviewed_through_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987),"earlier_candidates_reviewed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("earlier_candidates_reviewed" IN(0,1)),"review_source" TEXT NOT NULL,"rule_version" TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

add.name: fact_tax_point_basis_candidates
add.sql: CREATE TABLE fact_tax_point_basis_candidates(revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fact_tax_point_basis(revision_id),item_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(item_no>=0),"trigger" TEXT NOT NULL,"period" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987),"actual_date" TEXT,"gross_start_fen" INTEGER NOT NULL,"gross_end_fen" INTEGER NOT NULL,"source" TEXT NOT NULL,"receipt_stage" TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(revision_id,item_no)) STRICT

add.name: immutable_fact_tax_point_basis_DELETE
add.sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_fact_tax_point_basis_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON fact_tax_point_basis BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable fact_tax_point_basis'); END

add.name: immutable_fact_tax_point_basis_UPDATE
add.sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_fact_tax_point_basis_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON fact_tax_point_basis BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable fact_tax_point_basis'); END

add.sql: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_fact_tax_point_basis_candidates_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON fact_tax_point_basis_candidates BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable fact_tax_point_basis_candidates'); END

add.name: owner_fact_tax_point_basis
add.sql: CREATE TRIGGER owner_fact_tax_point_basis BEFORE INSERT ON fact_tax_point_basis WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_revision f JOIN subject s ON s.id=f.subject_id WHERE f.id=NEW.revision_id AND s.kind='tax_point_basis' AND f.period=NEW.period) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'typed fact ownership mismatch'); END

add.name: sealed_fact_tax_point_basis_candidates_insert
add.sql: CREATE TRIGGER sealed_fact_tax_point_basis_candidates_insert BEFORE INSERT ON fact_tax_point_basis_candidates WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_seal WHERE fact_id=NEW.revision_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'sealed revision'); END

add.name: sealed_fact_tax_point_basis_insert
add.sql: CREATE TRIGGER sealed_fact_tax_point_basis_insert BEFORE INSERT ON fact_tax_point_basis WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fact_seal WHERE fact_id=NEW.revision_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'sealed revision'); END
